tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Who Subhadip Mitra is and what the site covers: role, research areas, and the main essays, publications and projects, with links.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Keyword search across essays, publications, projects and measured results. Returns the best matches with their urls.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List essays, newest first, optionally filtered by tag or year. Older off-focus posts are excluded unless include_archived is true.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Full text of one essay as markdown. Interactive figures are omitted; the surrounding text is kept.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: Papers, preprints, technical disclosures, the thesis and the whitepaper, newest first, with venue, links and abstract.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Open-source projects with description, status, highlights, tech and links.

tools.name: list_results
tools.description: Measured results with their qualifiers (hardware, workload, models) and links to the post, paper or code that reproduces them.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, list_posts, get_post, list_results · Public sink: get_post, list_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, list_posts, get_post, list_results · Public sink: get_post, list_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
